description: This file defines function declarations related to WLAN hardware management, including conversions between string representations and internal enum types for radio states, security types, bandwidth, frequency, and encryption modes. It is part of the bwl::whm namespace and appears to serve as an interface for WLAN hardware abstraction layer utilities.

methods.name: radio_state_from_string
methods.description: Converts a string representing radio state to the eRadioState enum.

methods.name: radio_state_from_bool
methods.description: Converts a boolean flag indicating radio enable status to eRadioState.

methods.name: security_type_to_string
methods.description: Converts a WiFiSec security type to its string representation.

methods.name: security_type_from_string
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the corresponding WiFiSec security type.

methods.name: get_bandwidth_from_int
methods.description: Converts an integer bandwidth value to the eChannelScanResultChannelBandwidth enum.

methods.name: get_scan_result_encryption_modes_from_str
methods.description: Decodes a string of encryption modes into a vector of eChannelScanResultEncryptionMode.

methods.name: get_scan_result_operating_standards_from_str
methods.description: Decodes a string of standards into a vector of eChannelScanResultStandards.

methods.name: get_scan_security_modes_from_str
methods.description: Decodes a string of security modes into a vector of eChannelScanResultSecurityMode.
